title: SLI fractionation dashboard and commitment synthesis for reliability initiatives
creator: Anika Patel
description:
Background: As Redwood scales Dedicated and Private deployments, teams need clearer signals to partition (fractionate) SLIs and error budgets across micro-initiatives, feature groups, and customer cohorts. The current Initiative Hub surface aggregates error budget usage but lacks a first-class view that shows SLI decomposition, tranche allocations, and synthesized team commitments by cycle.

Goal: Deliver an SLI Fractionation Dashboard and automated Commitment Synthesis pipeline that: 1) decomposes service-level indicators into configurable tranches (by route, model, region, or customer tier), 2) visualizes tranche-level burn and projected runway, and 3) generates a synthesized commit recommendation (team-level error budget allocation and rollback thresholds) that can be pushed to the Initiative Hub and Console rollout gates.

Scope: MVP will include tranche definitions for latency and availability SLIs for inference runtime and API gateway; integration with existing telemetry (Prometheus/Tempo traces); a synthesis engine that recommends tranche allocations and return an advisory commit with confidence bands; export to Initiative Hub as proposed commitments. Not in scope: auto-executing rollbacks, enforcement of billing or quota controls, or SLO contract legalization.

Deliverables: 
- UI: SLI Fractionation Dashboard (Console) with filters (model, route, region, commit cycle) and drilldowns to per-tranche burn charts.
- Backend: Synthesis job that runs daily and on-demand, produces commitment artifacts (JSON) and confidence scoring.
- Integrations: Initiative Hub API endpoint to accept proposed commitments; telemetry mapping ruleset stored in repo; GitHub PR with synthesis logic.

Success metrics: 
- 80% of teams in pilot accept synthesized commitments at least once during the quarter.
- Mean time to identify high-burn tranche reduced from 4d -> 1d during incidents.
- Dashboard adoption: 12 teams with weekly usage in first 6 weeks post-launch.

Stakeholders: 
- PM: Anika Patel (owner)
- Engineering: Luca Moretti (backend lead), Mei Chen (frontend lead)
- Reliability/Oncall: SLO Stewards (rotation)
- Design: Priya Nair (visualization)

Risk & mitigation: 
- Telemetry gaps (incomplete labels) — mitigation: conservative default tranche mapping + a data quality checklist for teams.
- Overconfidence in synthesis recommendations — mitigation: include confidence bands and require team approval before changes land in Initiative Hub.

Artifacts & references: 
- Confluence PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/Reliability/SLI+Fractionation+MVP
- Demo prototype (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/SLI-Fractionation-Dashboard
- Synthesis engine draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/reliability-synthesis/pull/1234
- Telemetry mapping rules: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry-maps/blob/main/sli-tranches.yaml
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard renders tranche-level burn for latency and availability with 7d/30d windows and supports model/route/region filters
Synthesis job produces a commitment JSON with tranche->allocation mapping and confidence score; output schema documented in repo
Initiative Hub accepts proposed commitments via API and displays them as 'Proposed' pending team approval
End-to-end test covering one seeded pilot service (latency SLI) with synthetic telemetry runs in CI
